sources.title: Transvaal Colony
sources.note: Proclaimed 1 September 1900; Treaty of Vereeniging 31 May 1902; self-government 6 December 1906; Union 31 May 1910

notes: Cliopatria has no Transvaal Colony: British Africa covers the region. The dossier starts at the Treaty of Vereeniging (31 May 1902), not the 1 September 1900 proclamation, because the South African Republic dossier (af-07-b) already carries the British occupation of 1900-1902 as occupation_start/end by british-colonial-empire and dissolves the republic on 31 May 1902. Not typed: responsible government (infobox 6 December 1906; Het Volk won the election of 20 February 1907 and Botha became Prime Minister), Swaziland's transfer to the Transvaal (1903, Swaziland dossier), Chinese labour (1904-10). Area not on the page. Counterpart needing a dossier: union-of-south-africa (1910-1961), whose Cliopatria row 'South Africa' begins in 1932 (af-08 owns south-africa; the 1910-1931 years are drawn as British Africa). Gazetteer: names resolve (region Transvaal, places Vryheid and Volksrust).
